guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 consolidated net sales guidance range of approximately $2,650 to $2,675 million. On a constant currency basis, consolidated net sales are expected to increase 3.3% to 4.2%. The Company is also narrowing its full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to approximately $455 to $470 million, from $450 to $470 million previously. This outlook includes approximately $30 million of IEEPA tariff refunds, net of the impact on incentive compensation ("Net IEEPA Tariff Refunds"), expected to be recognized in 2026. The Company plans to share additional details of the 2026 outlook during its investor conference call.
